title: Chapter 129 Jiang Bei Leaves
content:
Chapter 129 Jiang Bei Leaves

In less than a moment, the footsteps rang out.

Yan Yan and the others quickly turned their heads and looked at it, and they immediately discovered A Wei walking towards him.

Feel Awei's breath.

The two of them looked solemn.

God Emperor Realm!

Moreover, both of them were in the Divine Emperor Realm, and they both felt a sense of oppression inexplicably.

Looking at the long knife on each other's waist, the two of them remained silent.

Don't tell them, this is a sword god.

It’s really possible, after all, even the God of Martial God and the God of Swords have come out in this force, and it’s nothing to create another God of Swords.

But it is obvious that Awei has not yet reached the realm of the sword god.

"You two, do you want to find our city lord?"

Seeing the two, Awei spoke directly.

Hearing this, Yan Yan and Hun Yue nodded quickly.

"Sir, we two are looking for you Lord Lord. There is something important to ask, please,

Before he finished speaking, Awei had already raised his hand to interrupt.

Seeing this, the two of them felt a deep heart.

Is it possible that it will fail?

But at this time, Awei said, "The City Lord, don't have to see you. If you have anything to do, just talk to me. I can make a decision for the City Lord."

Hearing this, the two of them looked a little shocked.

I didn't expect that the person in front of me actually had such energy in this deserted city.

It seems that if you have the chance in the future, you must flatter it.

Yan Yan glanced at Hunyue on the side, Hunyue nodded, and then told the purpose of the two.

After a long time, Awei was a little confused.

"What you mean is that you want to join our deserted city with the forces behind you, and there are no conditions?"

Hun Yue and Yan Yan were silent for a moment, then nodded.

"That's right, sir."

Originally, there were some small conditions at the beginning, but now that they have seen the strength of Huangcheng, they are no longer afraid to mention it.

If you want to conquer their Fire Spirit Star Domain and the Hungu Star Domain, you can just have hands.

When he was still there, Awei began to ponder.

No matter how you think of this kind of thing, it will be no harm to their deserted city.

After all, these are two star fields.

And they are two star fields with good strength.

"Okay, since that's the case, I'll agree."

At this time, Awei agreed directly.

There are no harm in every benefit, why not agree?

However, although Awei agreed verbally, he was still a little wary of the two of them.

The other party must have a purpose in doing this.

But he didn't ask, and even if he asked, the other party probably wouldn't say it.

He believed that everything would be revealed in the future.

Hearing Awei's reply, Yan Yan and Hun Yue also smiled.

Their plan was successful.

God Dynasty, right? I really want to see your ugly faces as if you had eaten shit when you heard this news.

Soon, Awei sent several Huangwei, who had high strength and status, to follow the two. With the help of the two top power leaders of the star field, everything would go extremely smoothly.

And above the city lord's mansion.

In the void.

Three days later, the competition between Jiangbei and Huangshou finally came to an end.

In the end, it ended with a move of Huang Shuai and defeat.

"Take it."

In the void, Jiang Bei smiled slightly.

Huang Shou also put away the magic sword and bowed his hand.

Because it was just a competition, neither of them tried their best.

Basically, they are testing each other.

Huang Shou is a sword cultivator and Jiang Bei is his own person. He naturally has no hostility towards Jiang Bei, and the sword will no longer have the power it should have.

It is also reasonable to lose to Jiangbei.

What's more, Jiangbei's martial arts realm is already extremely high.

Standing in the void, Jiang Bei smiled on the surface, but he was a little dissatisfied in his heart.

If you compete with your own people, you can't see your own strength at all.

However, it was not without benefits. I consolidated my realm, and Huang Shou also consolidated my realm of swordsmanship.

A win-win situation.

However, my goal is to test my current limit of strength.

Alas, it would be great if the city lord was there.

Back in his mansion.

Jiangbei is about to enter the state of cultivation again.

But at this time, a familiar voice came from outside the house.

"Brother Jiang, congratulations on breaking through the Super God Realm."

I saw Yu Qingfeng walking towards here with a pot of wine and smiling.

"Brother Yu, you, alas,"

Seeing Yu Qingfeng, Jiang Bei shook his head and smiled.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng was still in the realm of the Divine Emperor. With Yu Qingfeng's qualifications, he should have reached the realm of super gods one step ahead of him.

only,,

Looking at Yu Qingfeng's slightly thin face, you can see at a glance that this guy doesn't do serious things on weekdays.

However, he wouldn't say much.

Who can make people have true love?

Soon, the two of them went into the house to drink and discuss the story.

I drank until the next evening.

"Brother Yu."

At this time, Jiang Bei suddenly spoke.

Yu Qingfeng drank the last glass of wine, and his face turned red, "What's the matter?"

Jiang Bei smiled lightly and said, "I plan to go out."

"Go out?"

Jiang Bei nodded, "I believe there will be a stronger presence outside. I haven't fought with the strong for a long time."

Back then, his name as the God of Martial Arts was made by his fists.

Then he continued to enter a stable state and no more opponents until he met Lu Daosheng.

Then he woke him up with one punch.

Now, he has fallen into it again.

Blindly practicing is obviously not suitable for him.

Hearing Jiang Bei's words, Yu Qingfeng was silent for a moment and nodded.

"Okay, go ahead, but be careful."

Hearing this, Jiang Bei nodded, and then smiled faintly: "With my current strength, I really don't know who can put me in danger. If there is really someone, I might be a little excited, hahaha."

Finally, Jiang Bei left and went all the way south.

And Yu Qingfeng also told A Wei and others about this news.

Hearing the news of Jiang Bei's departure, A Wei and others didn't say much.

When Lu Daosheng left, he just explained a few words and didn't interfere with them too much.

Just guard the deserted city.

Now, there is no threat to the deserted city.

The dangerous ones are the star domain forces outside.

"A Wei, do you still remember what the city lord said?"

Aside, Gu Chen said in a calm voice.

Hearing this, A Wei nodded.

"Of course, what we have to do is to expand our power and improve our strength until we meet the power called the Divine Dynasty."

Before leaving, Lu Daosheng said that when we meet the Divine Dynasty, we must do our best to help the other party.

"Do you know anything about the Divine Dynasty?"

"This,"

Awei was silent.

At this time, he suddenly thought of An Xing.

These things should be done by An Xing.

"Hasn't An Xing come back yet?"

Awei frowned slightly.

Not long after Lu Daosheng left, An Xing asked for leave to return to the Wanling Realm.

Until now, he has not come back.

Thinking of An Xing, Awei was a little angry. This guy, I don't know what he has been doing, so unreliable.

Looking at Awei like this, Gu Chen felt a little funny.

"Well, I'll go back to the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm to find him."

Hearing this, Ah Wei was stunned, then smiled and said, "In that case, thank you, Brother Gu."

And Gu Chen didn't say much, he just got up and left, heading towards the time tunnel.

At this moment, Gu Chen didn't realize what he would see next.

It would simply overturn his cognition.

......

Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

Somewhere in the deserted city.

An Xing was dressed neatly, changed his usual state, and walked slowly to a mansion with an upright posture.

It was seen that An Xing was holding a bouquet of flowers in his hand.
